event_name: FIA Formula One World Championship German Grand Prix Saturday Post-Qualifying Press Conference Transcript
from: THE FLOOR Q: (James Roberts – F1 Racing) Sebastian, of all the laps that you've done in your career, where does that one rank, in front of your home crowd today?
title: Saturday Press Conference Transcript
to: do it here, just minutes away from where I come from, where I was born and grew up I think means a lot, so thanks for all the support this weekend; to see the fans, the red hats and the German flags waving all around the track, no matter, really cool, looking forward to tomorrow.
